title: North star vision vs shippable work
note:
Crafting a north star vision vs immediately shippable work. 

At payments I'm constantly doing the immediately shippable work as a C5. I'm never exposed to the north star vision work so I never get to apply that type of craft to real projects. [Example of my cards exploration]/ 

To grow, I think all designers need to get exposed to work that pushes the direction not ones that stay within it. And I know I can grow exponentially if given the opportunity to break out of the cycle. 

My proposal? Let me join the apprenticeship design program and shadow mentors that I already have a connection with. But this time they are my official mentors. 

My key areas of interest
- Shopify Retail: I've always been curious about hardware. I've played around with 3D modelling in my own time. I want to learn the design practices in a team that designs for the physical. 

- Sidekick: AI is the future and likely the default mode in which future generations engage with the internet. I want to learn about best practices in this space. What's important when interacting with AI? Here's a board of some of my favourite AI interactions to date.

From Are.na — channel: Site interactions
